ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast; estimated 1.8:1 ratio of high-intensity (white) pixels on lateral lobes to low-intensity (black) pixels in the central medial region.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Centralized low-intensity (dark) butterfly-shaped cluster originating at the peduncle and spreading proximally; bounded by large, high-intensity (white) contiguous regions on the distal 70% of each fluke lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a calculated vertex angle of approximately 82 degrees; bounding-box depth is roughly 12% of the total fluke vertical span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration profile; 15+ distinct peaks/valleys identified across both lobes; highest amplitude variations noted on the medial-right trailing edge (approx. 10-15 pixels vertical relief).
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical convex upward-sweeping curves originating from the notch and terminating in high-relief distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Scattered dark focal spots and mottled clusters situated along the transition boundary between white and black pigmentation zones; high-relief heterogeneous clusters (barnacles) visible at both tips.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Two distinct parallel diagonal dark linear marks (raking) on the left lateral white lobe; one prominent high-intensity (white) vertical linear scar located within the dark central region on the right side.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization on both distal fluke tips; prominent vertical depigmented (white) linear scar on the right-medial dark pigmentation zone.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique feathered pixel gradient interface between the central dark pigmentation and the outer white surfaces, characterized by high-frequency irregular 'bleeding' of black into white.
